attribution.note: Marcus states this in his own voice and endorses it.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves persistent novelty regardless of training volume. Its indefinite future scope makes forecast the appropriate kind.

contract.note: Persistent materially new situations is a fair plain reading. The contract appropriately distinguishes novelty from failure and allows simulated training coverage. Interpreting the unrestricted language as extending indefinitely determines what could settle it.

evidence.note: The dated research discusses rare or unseen inputs in existing models. It does not establish persistent novelty at every possible training volume.
Waymo's dated company disclosure describes simulated preparation before road encounters. It neither independently verifies coverage nor establishes that all future novelty can be exhausted.

reviews.rationale: No deadline is stated, and neither source meets the early-resolution rule. Existing long-tail problems do not establish unlimited future novelty; simulated preparation does not establish exhaustive coverage. The packet settles neither direction.
